verdict.rationale: The evidence documents an MCP server, an agent toolkit, and agentic commerce protocols. These let external AI clients and custom-built agents call PayPal APIs. Nothing in the pack shows an AI assistant built into PayPal's own dashboard or app that users can delegate tasks to. These are developer building blocks and external-client integrations, not an in-product assistant, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
